title: Longest Subarray With Maximum Bitwise AND
summary: Given an integer array nums, determine the length of the longest subarray that has a bitwise AND equal to the maximum possible bitwise AND of any subarray within nums.
statement: Given an integer array nums, determine the length of the longest subarray that has a bitwise AND equal to the maximum possible bitwise AND of any subarray within nums.
constraints: Maximize its bitwise AND value first, then return the greatest length attaining that value.
hints: A subarray AND cannot exceed any of its elements, so the maximum possible value is max(nums).
An AND equals that global maximum only when every included value equals it.
Find the longest consecutive run of elements equal to max(nums).
Each such run attains the maximum, while including any smaller or different-bit value makes the AND lower.
editorial: Each such run attains the maximum, while including any smaller or different-bit value makes the AND lower.

tests.explanation: The maximum possible AND is three, achieved by the consecutive pair [3,3].
The global maximum four alone is the only subarray attaining AND four, so length is one.
